\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-30},
  title = {Pipeline configuration lives in \texorpdfstring{\texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}}{params.yaml}},
  date = {2026-09-29},
  milestone = {M2: Reproducibility},
  topic = {Project Structure, Reproducibility},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {Everything configurable about the pipeline lives in \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml} and is declared per stage under \texttt{params:} in \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}yaml}: the seed, the reference date, the scope bounds, the split ratios, the feature sets, the model variants, and the thresholds of the success criteria.
Paths stay in \texttt{recommenditos/\allowbreak{}config.\allowbreak{}py}.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Python constants, as the course demo keeps in \texttt{train.\allowbreak{}py}: DVC sees a constant only through the hash of its module, so a changed hyperparameter retrains every variant, and \texttt{dvc params diff} and \texttt{dvc exp} cannot see it.
\item \texttt{config.\allowbreak{}py} reading \texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}: hides which stage reads which key.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} M2 is about a change rerunning what it should and nothing else.
DVC hashes the declared keys, \texttt{dvc params diff} shows what changed between two commits, and \texttt{dvc exp} can sweep a value without a code change.
Paths are not experiment variables and are derived from the module's location.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI read the demo's \texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}yaml} and \texttt{config.\allowbreak{}py} directly and reported that the demo declares no \texttt{params} on any stage.
It measured the consequence in a scratch DVC repository: with a declaration per key, a changed hyperparameter retrained one variant and not all of them.
Lukas reviewed the measurement and accepted.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-09-29, building the pipeline skeleton.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/params.yaml}{\texttt{params.\allowbreak{}yaml}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/dvc.yaml}{\texttt{dvc.\allowbreak{}yaml}}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/32}{issue \#32}.},
}
